result.stdout:
ModelSync CLI

Usage:
  modelsync version
  modelsync validate --scripts <directory>
  modelsync run --provider <provider> --connection-env <variable> --scripts <directory> --dry-run
  modelsync run --provider <provider> --connection-env <variable> --scripts <directory> --apply [--report-md <path>] [--report-json <path>]
  modelsync snapshot --provider <provider> --assembly <path> [--type <full-name,...>] --output <path>
  modelsync baseline --provider <provider> --connection-env <variable> --assembly <path> [--type <full-name,...>] --output <path>
  modelsync status --provider <provider> --connection-env <variable> --assembly <path> [--type <full-name,...>] [--report-md <path>] [--report-json <path>]
  modelsync export --provider <provider> --connection-env <variable> --assembly <path> [--type <full-name,...>] --output <directory>
  modelsync verify-drift --baseline <snapshot.json> --snapshot <snapshot.json>

Providers:
  sqlserver, mysql, mariadb, postgresql, sqlite

Options:
  --connection-env <name>     Reads the connection string from an environment variable. Default: MODELSYNC_CONNECTION_STRING.
  --connection <value>        Inline compatibility option; may be visible in process listings.
  --history-schema <schema>   Defaults to sec.
  --legacy-profile            Applies MigrationCompatibilityProfiles.LegacyEmbeddedSql.
  --dry-run                   Compares registered scripts without applying them.
  --apply                     Explicitly confirms migration execution.
  --assembly <path>           Assembly containing attributed ModelSync schema models.
  --type <names>              Optional comma-separated model type names.
  --source-commit <sha>       Optional source revision stored as snapshot metadata.
  --output <path>             Snapshot file or export directory.
